title: Northrop Grumman Releases First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: FALLS CHURCH, Va., April 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Northrop Grumman Corporation (NYSE: NOC) has released its first quarter 2026 financial results. A copy of the earnings release has been furnished in the company’s Form 8-K filing and is also available on the company's investor relations website
